name: Brin PR Commit Security Scan

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  brin-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get PR commits
        id: get-commits
        run: |
          # Get the list of commits in the PR
          COMMITS=$(gh pr view ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --json commits --jq '.commits[].oid')
          echo "commits<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "$COMMITS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Run Brin Scan on Commits
        id: brin-scan
        env:
          BRIN_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.BRIN_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          # Initialize summary variables
          BLOCKING_COUNT=0
          REVIEW_COUNT=0
          INCONCLUSIVE_COUNT=0
          HAS_FAILURE=false
          COMMENT_BODY="## Brin Security Scan Results\n\n"
          
          # Read commits from previous step
          COMMITS=$(echo "${{ steps.get-commits.outputs.commits }}" | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -v '^$')
          
          if [ -z "$COMMITS" ]; then
            echo "No commits found to scan."
            exit 0
          fi

          for COMMIT in $COMMITS; do
            echo "Scanning commit: $COMMIT"
            
            # Simulate Brin API call (Replace with actual Brin CLI or API call)
            # Assuming 'brin' CLI is available or we use curl to call Brin API
            # For this example, we assume a hypothetical 'brin scan' command exists
            # or we use a placeholder script. In a real scenario, you would install the Brin CLI.
            
            # Placeholder for actual Brin scan execution
            # SCAN_RESULT=$(brin scan $COMMIT --json)
            
            # Since we don't have the actual Brin CLI installed in this generic workflow,
            # we will simulate the logic structure. 
            # In production, replace this block with the actual Brin CLI invocation.
            
            # Example structure of expected JSON response from Brin:
            # { "status": "dangerous", "score": 25, "findings": [...] }
            
            # Mocking the scan for demonstration purposes only. 
            # Replace this with: SCAN_RESULT=$(brin scan $COMMIT --json)
            SCAN_RESULT='{"status": "clean", "score": 90, "findings": []}'
            
            # Parse results
            STATUS=$(echo $SCAN_RESULT | jq -r '.status')
            SCORE=$(echo $SCAN_RESULT | jq -r '.score')
            FINDINGS=$(echo $SCAN_RESULT | jq -r '.findings')
            
            COMMIT_SHORT=$(echo $COMMIT | cut -c1-7)
            
            if [ "$STATUS" == "dangerous" ] || [ "$SCORE" -lt 30 ]; then
              HAS_FAILURE=true
              BLOCKING_COUNT=$((BLOCKING_COUNT + 1))
              COMMENT_BODY+="### Commit $COMMIT_SHORT: ❌ Blocking\n"
              COMMENT_BODY+="Score: $SCORE\n"
              COMMENT_BODY+="Findings:\n$FINDINGS\n\n"
            elif [ "$STATUS" == "review" ]; then
              REVIEW_COUNT=$((REVIEW_COUNT + 1))
              COMMENT_BODY+="### Commit $COMMIT_SHORT: ⚠️ Review Required\n"
              COMMENT_BODY+="Score: $SCORE\n"
              COMMENT_BODY+="Findings:\n$FINDINGS\n\n"
            else
              INCONCLUSIVE_COUNT=$((INCONCLUSIVE_COUNT + 1))
              COMMENT_BODY+="### Commit $COMMIT_SHORT: ✅ Clean\n"
              COMMENT_BODY+="Score: $SCORE\n\n"
            fi
          done

          # Summary
          COMMENT_BODY+="---\n"
          COMMENT_BODY+="**Summary:**\n"
          COMMENT_BODY+="- Blocking: $BLOCKING_COUNT\n"
          COMMENT_BODY+="- Review: $REVIEW_COUNT\n"
          COMMENT_BODY+="- Clean/Inconclusive: $INCONCLUSIVE_COUNT\n"

          # Save comment body to file for the action
          echo "$COMMENT_BODY" > brin-comment.md
          
          # Set output for failure condition
          if [ "$HAS_FAILURE" == "true" ]; then
            echo "has_failure=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "has_failure=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Update PR Comment
        if: always()
        uses: mshick/add-pr-comment@v2
        with:
          message-id: brin-security-scan
          message-path: brin-comment.md
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          refresh-message-position: top

      - name: Remove Comment if Clean
        if: steps.brin-scan.outputs.has_failure == 'false'
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          comment-tag: brin-security-scan
          mode: delete
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Fail if Dangerous
        if: steps.brin-scan.outputs.has_failure == 'true'
        run: exit 1
